top_signals.title: Could Russia’s Secret Space Weapon Knock Out Starlink?
top_signals.summary: Reports emerged on November 23 that Russia is planning the launch of a nuclear-armed satellite, named Sputnik-S, into space “at any time in the coming weeks" after years of storing the alleged weapon in the Moscow region. That claim was swiftly denied by the Kremlin amid increasing unease over the militarization of space.
